added_comments.text: # Percent-encode values: account names may contain spaces, "&", etc.
# Unencoded, they yield a request target the origin rejects with 400.

rationale: The agent fixed the underlying defect in _build_url by properly percent-encoding query parameters via urlencode (and path segments in get_export), which makes the whole class of special-character inputs work rather than adding another entry to the FLAKY_ENDPOINTS workaround. The list_reports since/until Bogota-local timestamp behavior was not touched, and the added test asserts list_reports still works without retry.
